data.name: Project File Library
data.detailed_description:
Turn your folder into a library where you can organize your files and texts

Project File Library is an desktop file-library experience where folders and files become books. Choose a project folder from your computer, and the app transforms its contents into a small 3D scene that you can organize, revisit, and reshape.

Build Your Library

  • Choose a local folder and generate books from its files and folders.

  • Move books between the floor, ordinary shelves, and a special hidden shelf.

  • Add as many shelves as you need as your project grows.

  • Save different arrangements for different folders.

  • Restore your previous layouts from local library data.

Browse and Edit

  • Explore your folder through a file tree.

  • Double-click text files to open and edit them.

  • Split long text files into custom subgroups.

  • Combine subgroups into larger groups for easier navigation.

  • Save edited text, grouping data, layout data, and editor style settings locally.

A Local Workspace

Project File Library works with files on your own computer. Arrangement data, text grouping information, and style settings are stored inside a local .lib folder in the selected project root. The app is designed around local organization rather than online accounts or cloud storage.

data.short_description: Turn your project folder into a calm 3D file library. Choose a local folder, watch files and folders become books, organize them onto shelves, edit text files, create groups and subgroups, and save your layout locally.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU with WebGL support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Designed for local folders and text files. Very large folders or large text files may require more memory.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU or modern integrated GPU with DirectX 11/WebGL support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Designed for local folders and text files. Very large folders or large text files may require more memory.
